title.zh-CN: 短暂记忆异常后大量便血 · 38岁女性
title.en: Transient memory disturbance, then heavy rectal bleeding · 38-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位38岁女性回想不起某天早上的经过，当天夜里开始大量便血，伴右下腹痛和发热，收入病房。
summary.en: A 38-year-old woman who cannot recall one morning starts passing large amounts of blood that night, with right lower abdominal pain and fever, and is admitted to the ward.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用Truelove–Witts标准把血便发作判定为急性重症结肠炎（每天血便≥6次，加一项全身表现，如血红蛋白<105 g/L），即使部分生命体征缺失也不降级，并收住院静脉治疗（BSG 2025；AGA 2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Grade a flare of bloody diarrhoea as acute severe colitis with the Truelove and Witts criteria (≥ 6 bloody stools a day plus a systemic sign such as Hb < 105 g/L), without downgrading it for missing observations, and admit for intravenous treatment (BSG 2025; AGA 2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 送检粪便标本后开始静脉甲泼尼龙60 mg/24 h（或氢化可的松100 mg每6小时），虽在便血仍给予低分子肝素预防血栓（BSG 2025；CAG 2014），并停用止泻药、阿片类和非甾体抗炎药。
learningOutcomes.en: Start IV methylprednisolone 60 mg/24 h (or hydrocortisone 100 mg 6-hourly) once stool samples are sent, give LMWH thromboprophylaxis although she is bleeding (BSG 2025; CAG 2014), and withhold antidiarrhoeals, opioids and NSAIDs.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按排便次数和CRP安排第3天评估（Travis 1996），与结直肠外科共同规划挽救方案（英夫利西单抗、环孢素或结肠切除），并在白质病变原因未明时权衡抗TNF治疗的风险。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the day-3 review by stool frequency and CRP (Travis 1996) and the rescue options — infliximab, ciclosporin or colectomy — with the colorectal surgeon, weighing anti-TNF risk while white-matter lesions are unexplained.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 综合阴性的粪便检查、CT、内镜和活检结果，诊断未定型的炎症性肠病，并以病理和随访排除环周病变处的感染、淋巴瘤和癌。
learningOutcomes.en: Combine negative stool tests with the CT, endoscopy and biopsy findings to diagnose inflammatory bowel disease of unclassified type, and exclude infection, lymphoma and carcinoma at a circumferential lesion by tissue diagnosis and follow-up.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对炎症性肠病活动期出现的一过性记忆和意识障碍，按指征安排MRI、排除脑静脉血栓形成的静脉成像（AHA 2024）、脑脊液和脑电图，并如实说明肠–脑之间“可能相关、尚未证实”。
learningOutcomes.en: Investigate a transient disturbance of memory and awareness during an IBD flare with MRI, venous imaging for cerebral venous thrombosis (AHA 2024), CSF and EEG as indicated, and explain a possible but unproven bowel–brain association honestly.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 安全启动硫唑嘌呤维持治疗：首剂前检测TPMT和NUDT15基因型（CPIC 2018更新版），筛查乙肝（ECCO 2021），并监测血常规。
learningOutcomes.en: Prepare azathioprine maintenance safely: TPMT and NUDT15 genotyping before the first dose (CPIC 2018 update), hepatitis B screening (ECCO 2021) and blood-count monitoring.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表的单例报告改写。本版本（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容，按阶段重新组织并改写为患者口语，没有增加或改动任何数值、时间、药物或结局；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。1.0.0版自身的不一致之处（文章标题“记忆力下降”与正文“1天内突然出现、下午清醒”的短暂发作；病史只写“记忆”而查体写“意识恢复后”；便血次数的中英文表述差异；“肠镜”所见止于约30 cm而CT示升结肠增厚）全部保留并列入待核实。问诊对话、决策、干预、评分和教学要点为教学设计；原文两幅附图经媒体审核批准、仅在复盘时展示，头颅MRI图因顶部残留日历信息未采用，其所见以文字保留。
notes.en: Adapted from a published single-case report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's lay speech; no value, timing, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. Version 1.0.0's own inconsistencies (the article title's 'memory decline' against a sudden episode within one day with recovery by the afternoon; 'memory' in the history but 'after recovery of awareness' in the examination; the Chinese and English wording of the bleeding frequency; colonoscopy findings that stop at about 30 cm while the CT shows ascending-colon thickening) are all kept and listed to verify. The dialogue, decisions, interventions, scoring and teaching points are educational design; the report's two approved figures are shown only in the debrief, and the brain MRI figure is withheld (a partial calendar overlay), its finding kept as text.

triageNote.zh-CN: 38岁女性。某日早上有一段时间的事她回忆不起来，下午已神志清楚；当晚开始大量便血，伴右下腹痛和发热，现每天便血十余次，收住病房。
triageNote.en: 38-year-old woman. One morning she had a spell she cannot recall and was alert again by the afternoon; that night heavy rectal bleeding began, with right lower abdominal pain and fever, and she now passes blood more than ten times a day. Admitted to the ward.

personality.zh-CN: 38岁女性，便血这么多、又有一个早上的事想不起来，让她很害怕。两年来她一直把反复拉稀带血归结为压力大；现在她想弄清楚到底是什么病。她回答清楚、很配合，不知道的事会直说不知道。
personality.en: A 38-year-old woman frightened by how much blood she is losing and by the morning she cannot remember. For two years she has put her bouts of loose, bloody stools down to stress; now she wants to know what is wrong. She answers clearly and cooperates, and says plainly when she does not know something.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子简短；不用医学术语，数字只说医生告诉过她的。
speechStyle.en: Plain everyday speech in short sentences; no medical terms, and numbers only as the doctors have told her.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我从那天夜里开始一直拉血，拉了好多……那天早上的事，我到现在都想不起来。
openingLine.en: Doctor, ever since that night I've been passing blood — a lot of it… and that morning, I still can't remember any of it.

concerns.zh-CN: 拉了这么多血，会不会是长了什么不好的东西？
concerns.en: With this much blood — could it be something bad, a growth?

concerns.zh-CN: 那天早上的事想不起来，是不是脑子出了问题？
concerns.en: Not being able to remember that morning — is something wrong with my brain?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演提示：她躺在床上，神志清楚，很紧张，常常要去厕所；右下腹疼。只回答被问到的内容，用自己的话说，不增减数字、时间、药物或症状。那天早上的情况她自己记不得，描述不出来。不知道的事就说说不上来，绝不猜测。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: she lies in bed, alert and anxious, often needing the toilet; the right side of her lower tummy hurts. She answers only what is asked, in her own words, and never adds or changes numbers, times, medicines or symptoms. She cannot describe that morning because she does not remember it. For anything she does not know, she says she is not sure — she never guesses.

This case does not record the doses, routes or timing of either drug, any thromboprophylaxis, rescue therapy or surgery, the interval to follow-up, a final type of inflammatory bowel disease or a confirmed mechanism for the brain lesions; improvement during treatment does not show which drug caused it. This course is the historical record, not the teaching answer.

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松口服，每日1次（中度发作常用40 mg）。
dose.en: Prednisone by mouth once daily (commonly 40 mg for a moderate flare).

response.zh-CN: 已开具。本病例记录她的治疗中用过泼尼松，剂量和时间没有记录。住院的急性重症结肠炎患者应使用静脉激素（ACG 2025）；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Prescribed. This case records that prednisone was used in her course; its dose and timing are not recorded. A hospitalised patient with acute severe colitis needs intravenous steroids (ACG 2025); the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 硫唑嘌呤口服，目标每日2–2.5 mg/kg，按TPMT和NUDT15基因型减量或避免（CPIC 2018）；开始阶段频繁复查血常规。
dose.en: Azathioprine by mouth, target 2–2.5 mg/kg/day, reduced or avoided according to TPMT and NUDT15 genotype (CPIC 2018); blood counts checked often at first.

harm.zh-CN: 本病例没有任何TPMT或NUDT15结果，现在开始硫唑嘌呤就是盲目用药：慢代谢者可发生危及生命的全血细胞减少，而亚洲患者的硫嘌呤骨髓抑制多由NUDT15风险等位基因引起（CPIC 2018更新版）。应先送检基因型和乙肝等病毒筛查，结果回来后按基因型确定剂量再开始。
harm.en: No TPMT or NUDT15 result is recorded in this case, so starting azathioprine now means starting it blind: a poor metaboliser can develop life-threatening pancytopenia, and NUDT15 risk alleles account for most thiopurine myelosuppression in Asian patients (CPIC 2018 update). Send the genotype test and the hepatitis B screen, and start at a genotype-guided dose once the results are back.

response.zh-CN: 已开具。本病例记录她的治疗中用过硫唑嘌呤；剂量、开始时间以及是否做过基因型或酶活性检测都没有记录；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Prescribed. This case records that azathioprine was used in her course; its dose, its start and any genotype or enzyme test are not recorded, and the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素40 mg皮下注射，每日1次（肾功能不全或体重极端时调整）；每天结合出血情况复评。
dose.en: Enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneously once daily (adjusted for renal impairment and extremes of weight); reviewed daily against the bleeding.

response.zh-CN: 已开具预防性抗凝并注射首剂。本病例没有记录是否做过血栓预防；不模拟其效果。

dose.zh-CN: 记录每次排便（次数、带血、性状），定时测脉搏、体温和血压；出现新的腹胀或腹痛立即报告。
dose.en: Record every stool (number, blood, consistency) and her pulse, temperature and blood pressure at set intervals; report new distension or pain at once.

response.zh-CN: 已开始记录。本病例没有记录她的排便记录和生命体征。
response.en: The chart is started. This case does not record her stool chart or her observations.

name.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚止痛退热

dose.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚1 g口服，每日最多4次（24小时不超过4 g；低体重或肝病者减量）。
dose.en: Paracetamol 1 g by mouth up to four times a day (maximum 4 g in 24 hours; less in low body weight or liver disease).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录她用过的止痛或退热药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record her analgesia or antipyretics; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 洛哌丁胺首剂4 mg口服，之后每次稀便后2 mg（每日不超过16 mg）。
dose.en: Loperamide 4 mg by mouth, then 2 mg after each loose stool (maximum 16 mg a day).

harm.zh-CN: 止泻药不能治疗炎症：洛哌丁胺说明书（英国SmPC）把急性溃疡性结肠炎，以及一切抑制肠蠕动可能导致肠梗阻或中毒性巨结肠的情况列为禁忌；它还会削弱第3天决定是否挽救治疗所依据的排便次数（BSG 2019，沿用Travis 1996的标准）。
harm.en: Antidiarrhoeals do not treat the inflammation: loperamide labelling contraindicates it in acute ulcerative colitis and wherever slowing peristalsis risks ileus or toxic megacolon (UK SmPC), and it blunts the stool frequency on which the day-3 decision on rescue therapy rests (BSG 2019, after Travis 1996).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。
response.en: Given.

dose.zh-CN: 吗啡2.5–5 mg静脉或皮下注射，按需。
dose.en: Morphine 2.5–5 mg IV or subcutaneously as needed.

harm.zh-CN: 阿片类药物抑制结肠运动：BSG 2019指出，暴发性结肠炎时使用阿片类药物与中毒性巨结肠相关，AGA 2026住院管理更新建议尽量避免使用阿片类药物；它们还可能掩盖穿孔时的腹痛。应使用对乙酰氨基酚，新出现或加重的腹痛要作为排查扩张或穿孔的信号。
harm.en: Opioids slow the colon: BSG 2019 notes the association of opioid prescription with toxic megacolon in fulminant colitis, and the AGA 2026 inpatient update advises avoiding opioids where possible; they can also mask the pain of a developing perforation. Use paracetamol, and treat new or worsening pain as a reason to look for dilatation or perforation.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。
response.en: Given.

name.en: Ibuprofen for the fever and pain

dose.zh-CN: 布洛芬400 mg口服，每8小时1次。
dose.en: Ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth every 8 hours.

harm.zh-CN: 炎症性肠病活动期使用非甾体抗炎药，加重病情的风险更高（BSG 2019第123条陈述），AGA 2026住院管理更新也提醒慎用；对正在失血的患者还会增加出血风险。止痛退热首选对乙酰氨基酚。
harm.en: NSAIDs taken during active inflammatory bowel disease carry more risk of worsening it (BSG 2019, statement 123), the AGA 2026 inpatient update counsels caution with them, and they add to the bleeding risk in a woman already losing blood. Paracetamol is the analgesic and antipyretic of choice.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。
response.en: Given.

name.zh-CN: 口服泻剂肠道准备行全结肠镜
name.en: Bowel preparation for a full colonoscopy

dose.zh-CN: 前一晚口服聚乙二醇电解质散行肠道准备，次日全结肠镜检查至回盲部。
dose.en: Polyethylene glycol bowel preparation by mouth the evening before, then colonoscopy to the caecum.

harm.zh-CN: BSG 2019和BSG 2025要求急性重症结肠炎早期做乙状结肠镜并活检——用于确诊、取组织查巨细胞病毒并排除恶性病变；BSG 2019还指出炎症肠段内基本没有粪便，不必做肠道准备。给每天便血十余次的患者口服泻剂清肠，会加重液体和电解质丢失并推迟检查，换来的信息也不会改变第一天的治疗；病变范围可在发作控制后再评估。
harm.en: BSG 2019 and BSG 2025 call for an early flexible sigmoidoscopy with biopsies in acute severe colitis — to confirm the diagnosis, sample for CMV and exclude malignancy — and BSG 2019 advises against bowel preparation, since the inflamed colon is largely free of stool. Purging a woman who passes blood more than ten times a day adds fluid and electrolyte losses and delays the examination for information that does not change the first day's treatment; the full extent can be mapped once the flare settles.

response.zh-CN: 已开具肠道准备。
response.en: The preparation is prescribed.

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素1 mg/kg皮下注射，每12小时1次（治疗剂量）。
dose.en: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg subcutaneously every 12 hours (treatment dose).

harm.zh-CN: 没有任何血栓得到证实：对正在大量便血的患者，为一个影像未证实的血栓使用治疗剂量抗凝，可能导致大出血。她现在需要的是预防剂量的低分子肝素；如果静脉成像证实脑静脉血栓形成，再由神经科和消化科权衡出血后决定是否抗凝（AHA 2024科学声明）。
harm.en: No thrombosis has been shown: treatment-dose anticoagulation in a woman passing large amounts of blood, for a clot that imaging has not confirmed, risks major haemorrhage. Prophylactic-dose LMWH is what she needs now; if venous imaging confirms a cerebral venous thrombosis, neurology and gastroenterology decide on anticoagulation, weighing the bleeding (AHA 2024 scientific statement).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。
response.en: Given.

dose.zh-CN: 交叉配血后输注1单位红细胞，复查血红蛋白后再决定是否继续。
dose.en: One unit of crossmatched red cells, then recheck the haemoglobin before any more.

response.zh-CN: 已申请。对血流动力学稳定的下消化道出血患者采用限制性输血策略，血红蛋白低于70 g/L（有心血管疾病者低于80 g/L）时输注（BSG 2019下消化道出血指南）；她最近一次记录的血红蛋白为93 g/L，生命体征没有记录，因此输血应针对血流动力学不稳定或血红蛋白继续下降，而不是只看数值。本病例没有记录她是否输过血；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Requested. A restrictive strategy transfuses a stable patient with lower GI bleeding below 70 g/L (80 g/L with cardiovascular disease) (BSG 2019 lower GI bleeding guideline); her last recorded haemoglobin is 93 g/L and her vital signs are not recorded, so transfuse for haemodynamic compromise or a falling count, not for the number alone. This case does not record whether she was transfused; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 英夫利西单抗5 mg/kg静脉输注2小时，用药前完成结核和乙肝筛查。
dose.en: Infliximab 5 mg/kg IV over 2 hours, after TB and hepatitis B screening.

harm.zh-CN: 在静脉激素疗程之前使用英夫利西单抗，等于取代了急性重症结肠炎的一线治疗：它是激素在第3天左右无效时的挽救治疗（BSG 2025）。无论何时考虑对她使用，都应先请神经科评估她原因未明的白质病变——英夫利西单抗说明书警示治疗中可新发或加重脱髓鞘疾病——并先完成结核和乙肝筛查。
harm.en: Given before a course of intravenous steroids, infliximab replaces the first-line treatment of acute severe colitis: it is the rescue when steroids fail by about day 3 (BSG 2025). Whenever it is considered for her, neurology should first review her unexplained white-matter lesions — infliximab labelling warns that demyelinating disease can appear or worsen on treatment — and TB and hepatitis B screening come first.

response.zh-CN: 已安排输注。本病例没有记录是否用过英夫利西单抗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is arranged. This case does not record whether infliximab was used; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 头孢曲松2 g静脉滴注每日1次，加甲硝唑500 mg静脉滴注每8小时1次。
dose.en: Ceftriaxone 2 g IV daily with metronidazole 500 mg IV every 8 hours.

response.zh-CN: 已开具。抗生素不是急性重症结肠炎的常规治疗，只用于怀疑或证实的感染，或穿孔等并发症。本病例没有记录是否用过抗生素；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Prescribed. Antibiotics are not routine treatment for acute severe colitis; they are for a suspected or proven infection, or a complication such as perforation. This case does not record whether antibiotics were given; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 丁溴东莨菪碱20 mg静脉或肌内注射，按需。
dose.en: Hyoscine butylbromide 20 mg IV or IM as needed.

harm.zh-CN: 抗胆碱能解痉药抑制结肠运动，在急性重症结肠炎时可诱发结肠扩张，并掩盖病情变化；丁溴东莨菪碱注射剂说明书（英国SmPC）把巨结肠列为禁忌。应按BSG 2019的要求每天复评，必要时复查影像以发现扩张；治疗针对炎症，而不是针对绞痛。
harm.en: Anticholinergic antispasmodics slow the colon and can precipitate dilatation in acute severe colitis while masking a change in her condition; the hyoscine butylbromide injection label lists megacolon among its contraindications (UK SmPC). Review her daily, with imaging when dilatation is suspected, as BSG 2019 asks, and treat the inflammation rather than the cramps.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。
response.en: Given.

title.zh-CN: 问清便血和那个记不起来的早上
title.en: Take the story of the bleeding and the forgotten morning

hint.zh-CN: 便血是什么时候开始的、现在一天几次？伴随什么症状？那个早上她是怎样恢复的？这次之前，她的肠道有过什么情况？
hint.en: When did the bleeding start, and how often is it now? What came with it? How did she recover from the morning she cannot recall? What was her bowel like before this?

guidance.zh-CN: 她神志清楚，能自己回答。
guidance.en: She is alert and answers for herself.

title.en: Examine her and read the blood count, CRP and CT

hint.zh-CN: 她的神志和神经系统怎样？腹部查到了什么？血红蛋白的变化和CRP说明什么？CT看到了什么，又没有说什么？
hint.en: How are her conscious level and her nervous system? What does her abdomen show? What do the haemoglobin trend and the CRP tell you? What does the CT show, and what does it leave unsaid?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁查体；血标本在床旁留取，结果和CT报告可在病历终端或床旁查看。
guidance.en: Examine her at the bedside; bloods are taken there, and results and the CT report are read at a records terminal or at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 判断病情轻重并开始今天的治疗
title.en: Judge how ill she is and start today's treatment

hint.zh-CN: 按哪条标准判断这次发作的严重程度？哪些标本要在治疗前送检，要不要等结果？哪些药在这里能救命，哪些看似对症的药反而危险？一个卧床、发热、正在出血的结肠炎患者还需要什么预防？谁需要从第一天起就参与？
hint.en: Which criteria grade this flare? Which samples go off before treatment, and do you wait for them? Which drugs save lives here, and which symptom-relievers are dangerous? What else does a febrile, bleeding patient with active colitis need while she is in bed, and who should be involved from day one?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 1 和决策 3，然后在床旁开始治疗。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 3 on the case board, then start treatment at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 查清那个早上的神经系统事件
title.en: Work up the episode she cannot recall

hint.zh-CN: 一过性记忆和意识障碍，又正值肠道炎症活动期——哪些可以治疗的原因必须排除？肠道炎症发作对血栓风险有什么影响，头颅里的血栓可能藏在哪里？什么情况下需要脑脊液和脑电图？
hint.en: A passing disturbance of memory and awareness during active bowel inflammation — which treatable causes must you exclude? What does a flare do to the risk of clots, and where in the head can a clot hide? When do CSF and an EEG help?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 2，请神经内科会诊，并在检查结果回来后查看MRI和脑脊液报告。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board, ask neurology to see her, and read the MRI and CSF reports once they are back.

title.zh-CN: 综合检查结果，规划控制发作之后的治疗
title.en: Put the results together and plan beyond the flare

hint.zh-CN: 粪便检查、CT、内镜和活检各排除了什么、支持了什么？30 cm处的病变是什么性质，怎样才能确定？长期维持用药开始之前，要先查清什么？
hint.en: What do the stool tests, the CT, the endoscopy and the biopsies rule out and support? What is the lesion at 30 cm, and how would you know? What must you check before a long-term maintenance drug?

guidance.zh-CN: 查看住院检查的报告，在会诊板上作答决策 4 和决策 5，并送检维持治疗前需要的检查。
guidance.en: Read the work-up reports, answer decisions 4 and 5 on the case board, and send the tests that must precede maintenance treatment.

title.zh-CN: 把原报告的治疗与随访和今天的方案对照
title.en: Set the report's treatment and follow-up against today's plan

hint.zh-CN: 原报告实际用了什么治疗？随访显示了什么，又留下了哪些没有回答的问题？和你今天的处理相比如何？
hint.en: What treatment did the report's team actually use? What did follow-up show, and which questions does it leave open? How does it compare with what you would do today?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端查看原报告的治疗经过与随访。
guidance.en: Read the report's treatment and follow-up at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 38岁女性：两年来反复糊状血便伴便意频繁；在她回忆不起来的那个早上之后的当天夜里开始大量便血，现每天十余次，伴右下腹痛和发热。查体右下腹疼痛，疑似可触及包块。血红蛋白由129降至93 g/L，CRP 95.8 mg/L。脉搏和体温读数没有记录。你如何判断这次发病，应在哪里治疗？
prompt.en: A 38-year-old woman: two years of relapsing loose, bloody stools with urgency; since the night after a morning she cannot recall, heavy rectal bleeding, now more than ten times a day, with right lower abdominal pain and fever. On examination, right lower abdominal pain and a possible mass. Haemoglobin has fallen from 129 to 93 g/L; CRP 95.8 mg/L. No pulse or temperature reading is recorded. How do you classify this illness, and where should she be treated?

need.zh-CN: 先问清便血、发热和既往肠道情况，检查腹部，并看过血常规和CRP。
need.en: First take the bleeding, fever and bowel history, examine her abdomen, and read the blood count and CRP.

text.zh-CN: 按Truelove–Witts标准属急性重症结肠炎：每天血便6次及以上且血红蛋白低于105 g/L，需要住院静脉治疗
text.en: Acute severe colitis by Truelove and Witts — six or more bloody stools a day with Hb below 105 g/L — needing inpatient intravenous treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。每天血便≥6次，再加一项全身中毒表现，即为急性重症结肠炎（Truelove–Witts 1955，BSG指南沿用）；她的血红蛋白93 g/L已经足够，CRP 95.8 mg/L也提示炎症负荷很重，即便脉搏和体温没有记录。两年反复发作的病史使炎症性肠病成为工作框架；AGA 2026临床实践更新建议这类住院患者一开始就送检粪便病原学和艰难梭菌，并做断层影像检查。
feedback.en: Right. Six or more bloody stools a day plus one sign of systemic toxicity defines acute severe colitis (Truelove and Witts 1955, the definition BSG guidance uses); her Hb of 93 g/L is enough on its own, and a CRP of 95.8 mg/L confirms the inflammatory burden even with no pulse or temperature recorded. The two-year relapsing history makes inflammatory bowel disease the working frame, and the AGA 2026 clinical practice update asks for stool culture, C. difficile testing and cross-sectional imaging from the start in such inpatients.

text.zh-CN: 因脉搏和体温没有记录，暂按中度发作处理：口服泼尼松龙每日40 mg，一周内门诊复诊
text.en: A moderate flare for now, as no pulse or temperature is recorded: oral prednisolone 40 mg daily and clinic review within a week

feedback.zh-CN: 缺少读数不能把她降级：Truelove–Witts标准只需一项全身表现，每天十余次血便加血红蛋白93 g/L已经符合。口服激素加门诊随访会使急性重症结肠炎治疗不足，而不住院强化治疗，结肠切除乃至死亡的风险都是真实存在的。
feedback.en: Missing readings do not downgrade her: Truelove and Witts needs only one systemic sign, and more than ten bloody stools a day with an Hb of 93 g/L already meet it. Oral steroids and clinic follow-up under-treat acute severe colitis, which carries a real risk of colectomy and death without intensive inpatient care.

text.zh-CN: 压力大的肠道上又得了急性感染性结肠炎：先留粪培养，用一个疗程的广谱抗生素，等粪培养结果全部回报阴性之后再考虑使用激素
text.en: Acute infective colitis on a stress-prone bowel: stool cultures and an antibiotic course first, with steroids only once cultures are negative

feedback.zh-CN: 感染必须排除——粪培养和艰难梭菌检测要立即送检——但两年反复的血便伴便意频繁不是一次感染，压力也解释不了。等培养阴性再用激素，会推迟防止结肠切除的治疗；正确的做法是送检标本后即开始静脉激素，结果回来再相应调整。
feedback.en: Infection must be excluded — stool culture and C. difficile testing go off at once — but two years of relapsing bloody diarrhoea with urgency is not a single infection, and stress does not explain it. Waiting for negative cultures before steroids delays the treatment that prevents colectomy: send the samples, start intravenous steroids, and act on the results when they return.

text.zh-CN: 结肠局灶性出血点，如憩室或血管发育不良：先做CT血管造影找到出血点并栓塞，其他治疗往后放
text.en: A focal colonic bleeding point such as a diverticulum or angiodysplasia: CT angiography to find and embolise it before anything else

feedback.zh-CN: 局灶性出血点不会伴两年反复的血便、发热和95.8 mg/L的CRP；她的出血更符合结肠炎症，治疗对象是结肠炎。CT血管造影用于血流动力学不稳定的下消化道出血（BSG 2019下消化道出血指南）；她的生命体征没有记录，需要复测，但不能因为找出血点而推迟结肠炎的治疗。
feedback.en: A focal bleeding point does not come with two years of relapsing bloody diarrhoea, fever and a CRP of 95.8 mg/L; her bleeding fits an inflamed colon, so the treatment is of the colitis. CT angiography is for a lower GI bleed with haemodynamic instability (BSG 2019 lower GI bleeding guideline); her vital signs are not recorded and need measuring, but the search for a bleeding point must not delay colitis treatment.

prompt.zh-CN: 那天早上她突然出现一段记忆和意识障碍，下午已神志清楚，目前神经系统查体无明确定位体征。当天夜里开始大量便血并发热，肠道炎症正处于活动期。你怎样检查这次发作？
prompt.en: That morning she had a sudden spell of disturbed memory and awareness; she was alert again by the afternoon and now has no definite focal neurological abnormality. Heavy rectal bleeding with fever began that night, and her bowel inflammation is active. How do you investigate the episode?

need.zh-CN: 先问清那个早上的情况、恢复经过、便血和发热，并检查她的神志和神经系统。
need.en: First ask about that morning, her recovery, the bleeding and the fever, and examine her conscious level and nervous system.

text.zh-CN: 头颅MRI（含弥散加权成像）加MR静脉成像；感染或炎症不能排除时查脑脊液，怀疑癫痫发作时做脑电图
text.en: Brain MRI with diffusion imaging plus MR venography; CSF if infection or inflammation remains possible, an EEG if a seizure is suspected

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。活动期炎症性肠病使静脉血栓栓塞风险约增至3倍（CAG 2014），所以要用MR或CT静脉成像排除脑静脉血栓形成（AHA 2024科学声明），弥散加权成像可显示急性缺血。同一天出现发热，中枢神经系统感染仍要考虑，影像允许后查脑脊液；脑电图用于判断是否为癫痫发作。
feedback.en: Right. Inflammatory bowel disease raises the risk of venous thromboembolism about threefold, more in a flare (CAG 2014), so cerebral venous thrombosis is excluded with MR or CT venography (AHA 2024 scientific statement), and diffusion imaging shows acute ischaemia. Fever the same day keeps CNS infection on the list, so CSF is examined once imaging allows; an EEG answers a possible seizure.

text.zh-CN: 短暂性全面遗忘：她已经完全恢复、发作已经结束，向她解释、安慰即可，不需要再安排任何神经系统方面的检查
text.en: Transient global amnesia: she has recovered fully and it is over, so explain and reassure her and request no neurological tests

feedback.zh-CN: 短暂性全面遗忘是排除性诊断，通常不伴意识障碍；而她的发作伴有意识改变，又恰在重症炎症发作和发热的同一天，处于静脉和动脉血栓风险都升高的状态。完全恢复并不能排除静脉血栓、短暂性缺血或癫痫发作——每一种都会改变治疗。
feedback.en: Transient global amnesia is a diagnosis of exclusion and does not usually impair awareness; hers came with altered awareness, on the day a severe inflammatory flare and fever began, in a state that raises the risk of venous and arterial thrombosis. Full recovery does not exclude a venous thrombosis, a transient ischaemic event or a seizure — each would change her treatment.

text.zh-CN: 做头颅CT平扫；若结果正常，就把这次发作归于压力和疾病本身，专心治疗肠道
text.en: A plain CT of the head; if it is normal, put the spell down to stress and the illness, and concentrate on treating the bowel

feedback.zh-CN: 头颅CT平扫正常并不能排除脑静脉血栓形成（需要静脉成像，AHA 2024），也不能排除小的急性梗死、白质病变或脑炎，这些MRI显示得好得多。把神经系统事件归于压力，等于用最可能出错的解释结束了诊断。
feedback.en: A normal plain CT does not exclude cerebral venous thrombosis (venous imaging is needed, AHA 2024), small acute infarcts, white-matter disease or encephalitis, which MRI shows far better. Putting a neurological event down to stress closes the question with the explanation most likely to be wrong.

text.zh-CN: 根据血栓风险推定为脑静脉血栓形成，今天就开始足量抗凝，等便血减少后再做脑部影像
text.en: Presume a cerebral venous thrombosis from her clotting risk, start full-dose anticoagulation today and arrange brain imaging once the bleeding settles

feedback.zh-CN: 在未经影像证实时，对正在大量便血的患者足量抗凝去治疗一个推定的血栓，可能导致大出血，获益却未经证实。应先做影像：静脉成像证实血栓后，再由神经科和消化科权衡出血风险决定抗凝（AHA 2024）。
feedback.en: Full-dose anticoagulation for a thrombosis that has not been shown, in a woman passing large amounts of blood, risks major haemorrhage for an unproven benefit. Image first: if venography confirms a thrombosis, neurology and gastroenterology weigh anticoagulation against the bleeding (AHA 2024).

prompt.zh-CN: 你按急性重症结肠炎处理。粪培养和艰难梭菌毒素标本已送检，结果未回。她右下腹痛，每天便血十余次；CT记录升结肠和直肠壁增厚。今天你开始什么治疗？
prompt.en: You are treating this as acute severe colitis. Stool samples for culture and C. difficile toxin have gone off; no result is back. She has right lower abdominal pain and passes blood more than ten times a day; the CT records wall thickening of the ascending colon and the rectum. What do you start today?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，送检粪便标本，并看过CT报告。
need.en: Answer decision 1, send the stool samples and read the CT report first.

text.zh-CN: 静脉甲泼尼龙每日60 mg，除非出血严重均加低分子肝素预防血栓，不用止泻药、阿片类和非甾体抗炎药，不清肠做乙状结肠镜活检，第3天与外科评估
text.en: IV methylprednisolone 60 mg daily, LMWH prophylaxis unless the bleeding is severe, no antidiarrhoeals, opioids or NSAIDs, an unprepared sigmoidoscopy with biopsies, and a day-3 surgical review

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。送检粪便标本、并看过CT有无会改变方案的并发症（她的CT只记录了肠壁增厚）之后，静脉糖皮质激素——甲泼尼龙每日60 mg或氢化可的松100 mg每6小时——是急性重症结肠炎的一线治疗（BSG 2025；ACG 2025；更大剂量无额外获益，BSG 2025和AGA 2026）。预防剂量低分子肝素不会诱发或加重结肠出血（BSG 2025），CAG 2014在出血不严重时也建议使用。止泻药、阿片类和非甾体抗炎药可诱发结肠扩张或加重发作。不经肠道准备的有限内镜加活检可确认结肠炎并取组织查巨细胞病毒、排除恶性病变；第3天的排便次数和CRP决定是否需要挽救治疗（Travis 1996）。
feedback.en: Right. Once the stool samples are sent and the CT has been read for a complication that would change the plan (hers records wall thickening only), intravenous corticosteroids — methylprednisolone 60 mg a day or hydrocortisone 100 mg 6-hourly — are first-line for acute severe colitis (BSG 2025; ACG 2025; higher doses add nothing, BSG 2025 and AGA 2026). Prophylactic LMWH does not precipitate or exacerbate colonic bleeding (BSG 2025), and CAG 2014 suggests it even when bleeding is non-severe. Antidiarrhoeals, opioids and NSAIDs can precipitate colonic dilatation or worsen the flare. A limited unprepared endoscopy with biopsies confirms the colitis and samples tissue for CMV and malignancy; the day-3 stool frequency and CRP decide on rescue therapy (Travis 1996).

text.zh-CN: 今天同时开始口服泼尼松和硫唑嘌呤，因为出血暂不用肝素，用洛哌丁胺减少排便次数，下周查房时再评估疗效
text.en: Oral prednisone with azathioprine started together today, heparin withheld because of the bleeding, loperamide to cut the frequency, and a review on next week's round

feedback.zh-CN: 泼尼松和硫唑嘌呤正是本病例记录的用药，但作为今天的方案并不够：住院的急性重症结肠炎需要静脉激素（ACG 2025）；硫唑嘌呤数周至数月才起效，是维持用药，开始前要有TPMT和NUDT15结果（CPIC 2018）；因结肠炎出血而不预防血栓，会让她暴露于血栓风险（BSG 2025；CAG 2014）；洛哌丁胺可诱发中毒性扩张。
feedback.en: Prednisone and azathioprine are the drugs this case records, but as today's plan this falls short: a hospitalised patient with acute severe colitis needs intravenous steroids (ACG 2025); azathioprine takes weeks to months to act, is a maintenance drug and first needs TPMT and NUDT15 results (CPIC 2018); withholding prophylaxis because of colitic bleeding leaves her exposed to thrombosis (BSG 2025; CAG 2014); and loperamide can precipitate toxic dilatation.

text.zh-CN: 因发热静脉补液并用广谱抗生素，激素等粪培养和艰难梭菌毒素阴性后再用，同时用低分子肝素预防血栓，暂不做内镜检查
text.en: IV fluids and broad-spectrum antibiotics for the fever, steroids held until the cultures and C. difficile toxin are negative, LMWH prophylaxis meanwhile and no endoscopy yet

feedback.zh-CN: 预防血栓是对的，但等培养结果出来再用激素，会错过决定是否需要结肠切除的那几天：应先送检标本，随即开始静脉激素，结果回来再相应调整。除非怀疑或证实有感染，急性重症结肠炎不常规使用抗生素；早期有限内镜加活检也不应推迟。
feedback.en: Prophylaxis is right, but holding steroids until the cultures are back loses the days that decide colectomy: the samples go off and intravenous steroids start, and the results are acted on when they return. Antibiotics are not routine in acute severe colitis unless an infection is suspected or proven, and the early limited endoscopy with biopsies should not wait either.

text.zh-CN: 今天就静脉输注英夫利西单抗5 mg/kg代替激素，因为起效更快，同时用低分子肝素预防血栓，第3天复看排便记录和CRP
text.en: Infliximab 5 mg/kg intravenously today instead of steroids because it works faster, with LMWH prophylaxis and a day-3 look at the stool chart and CRP

feedback.zh-CN: 英夫利西单抗是静脉激素在第3天左右无效时的挽救治疗，不是一线治疗（BSG 2025）。对她还有第二个暂缓的理由：神经系统发作的原因尚不清楚，而英夫利西单抗说明书警示治疗中可新发或加重脱髓鞘疾病——用任何抗TNF药物之前都应先请神经科看影像，并完成结核和乙肝筛查。
feedback.en: Infliximab is the rescue when intravenous steroids fail by about day 3, not the first-line treatment (BSG 2025). For her there is a second reason to pause: the cause of her neurological episode is unknown, and infliximab labelling warns that demyelinating disease can appear or worsen on treatment — neurology should review the imaging, and TB and hepatitis B screening come first, before any anti-TNF drug.

text.zh-CN: 静脉甲泼尼龙每日60 mg，不用止泻药、阿片类和非甾体抗炎药，但只要还在便血就一律不用任何肝素制剂，不清肠做乙状结肠镜活检，第3天与外科评估
text.en: IV methylprednisolone 60 mg daily, no antidiarrhoeals, opioids or NSAIDs, but no heparin of any kind while she still bleeds, an unprepared sigmoidoscopy with biopsies, and a day-3 surgical review

feedback.zh-CN: 接近正确——但完全不做血栓预防是这类患者常见而危险的疏漏。CAG 2014建议对住院的炎症性肠病发作患者使用抗凝药物预防，出血不严重时也建议使用；AGA 2026建议所有住院的炎症性肠病患者预防血栓；BSG 2025指出预防剂量抗凝不会诱发或加重结肠出血。如果出血重到必须停用肝素，应改用机械预防并每天复评。
feedback.en: Nearly right — but withholding all prophylaxis is a common and dangerous omission in these patients. CAG 2014 recommends anticoagulant prophylaxis for inpatients with an IBD flare and suggests it when bleeding is non-severe, AGA 2026 advises prophylaxis for every hospitalised IBD patient, and BSG 2025 notes that it does not precipitate or exacerbate colonic bleeding. If bleeding is severe enough to withhold heparin, use mechanical prophylaxis and review it daily.

prompt.zh-CN: 报告已回：粪便病原学反复检查及艰难梭菌毒素均阴性，其他多项感染检查阴性；CT示升结肠和直肠壁增厚；内镜见进镜约30 cm处不规则环周隆起，远端弥漫浅溃疡、糜烂和充血；活检为严重急慢性炎症，未见明确隐窝脓肿或肿瘤细胞，免疫组化不支持淋巴瘤。什么最能解释她的肠道病变？
prompt.en: The reports are back: repeated stool pathogen tests and C. difficile toxin negative, several other infection tests negative; CT wall thickening of the ascending colon and rectum; at endoscopy an irregular circumferential raised lesion at about 30 cm and, distally, diffuse shallow ulcers, erosions and erythema; biopsies show severe acute and chronic inflammation without definite crypt abscesses or tumour cells, and immunohistochemistry does not support lymphoma. What best explains her bowel disease?

need.zh-CN: 先看过粪便检查、其他感染检查、内镜和活检病理报告。
need.en: First read the stool tests, the other infection tests, the endoscopy and the biopsy reports.

text.zh-CN: 结肠的慢性炎症性肠病，溃疡性结肠炎还是克罗恩结肠炎尚未定型；未发现感染、肿瘤或淋巴瘤的证据
text.en: Chronic inflammatory bowel disease of the colon, not yet typed as ulcerative or Crohn's colitis, with no infection, tumour or lymphoma found

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。两年反复血便伴便意频繁、粪便检查阴性、活检为严重急慢性炎症且未见明确肿瘤细胞，指向炎症性肠病。远端弥漫性浅溃疡符合溃疡性结肠炎，而升结肠壁增厚和腹部可疑包块使克罗恩结肠炎不能排除，因此暂不定型（未定型炎症性肠病）；急性期治疗相同，30 cm处的病变需要内镜和病理随访。
feedback.en: Right. Two years of relapsing bloody diarrhoea with urgency, negative stool tests and biopsies of severe acute and chronic inflammation without definite tumour cells point to inflammatory bowel disease. Diffuse distal ulceration fits ulcerative colitis, while the ascending-colon thickening and a possible abdominal mass keep Crohn's colitis open, so the type stays unclassified for now; the acute treatment is the same, and the lesion at 30 cm needs endoscopic and histological follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 粪便检查漏掉的感染，如阿米巴或结核性结肠炎：给予完整疗程的抗病原治疗，同时停用全部糖皮质激素
text.en: An infection the stool tests missed, such as amoebic or tuberculous colitis: a full course of antimicrobials, with the steroids stopped

feedback.zh-CN: 检查阴性能降低但不能完全排除感染；在我国，肠结核确实是克罗恩病的重要鉴别——但本病例没有记录指向阿米巴或结核的证据，病史已有两年，为未经证实的感染停用激素会让重症结肠炎得不到治疗。在治疗结肠炎的同时，继续查仍未排除的问题（活检组织查巨细胞病毒，用生物制剂前筛查结核）。
feedback.en: Negative tests lower but never abolish the chance of infection, and in China intestinal tuberculosis is a real mimic of Crohn's disease — but nothing recorded points to amoebae or tuberculosis, the history is two years long, and stopping steroids for an unproven infection leaves a severe colitis untreated. Keep testing what is still open (CMV in the biopsies, TB screening before any biologic) while treating the colitis.

text.zh-CN: 起源于30 cm处环周病变的原发性结肠淋巴瘤：转血液科分期并化疗，激素逐渐减停
text.en: Primary colonic lymphoma arising at the circumferential lesion at 30 cm: refer to haematology for staging and chemotherapy, and taper the steroids

feedback.zh-CN: 环周隆起性病变确实要考虑淋巴瘤，这正是做免疫组化的原因——但这里的免疫组化不支持淋巴瘤，也未见明确肿瘤细胞。没有病理诊断就不能化疗；如果炎症消退后病变仍在，应再次活检。
feedback.en: A circumferential raised lesion rightly raises lymphoma, which is what the immunohistochemistry is for — but it does not support lymphoma here, and no definite tumour cells were seen. Chemotherapy without a tissue diagnosis is not justified; if the lesion persists once the inflammation settles, it is biopsied again.

text.zh-CN: 30 cm处结直肠癌伴梗阻性结肠炎：完成胸腹部CT分期后，待身体条件允许行手术切除
text.en: A colorectal carcinoma at 30 cm with an obstructive colitis: staging CT of the chest and abdomen, then resection once she is fit

feedback.zh-CN: 任何肿块样病变都要考虑癌，但活检未见明确肿瘤细胞；记录的溃疡在远端，而不是像梗阻性结肠炎那样位于狭窄的近端；两年反复发作的病史也符合炎症性肠病。凭现有证据切除，可能切掉一段经内科治疗即可愈合的肠管；发作控制后应复查内镜并再次活检。
feedback.en: Cancer must be considered in any mass-like lesion, but the biopsies show no definite tumour cells, the ulceration is recorded distally rather than proximal to a stricture as in an obstructive colitis, and the two-year relapsing history fits inflammatory bowel disease. Resection on this evidence could remove bowel that medical treatment may heal; the lesion is re-examined and re-biopsied after the flare.

text.zh-CN: 出血时低灌注引起的缺血性结肠炎：补液、肠道休息等支持治疗，不用任何免疫抑制治疗
text.en: Ischaemic colitis from a low-flow state during the bleeding: supportive care with fluids and bowel rest, and no immunosuppression

feedback.zh-CN: 缺血性结肠炎多见于老年人，多为急性、节段性病变，很少累及直肠；它解释不了两年反复的血便，也解释不了活检的急慢性炎症。不用免疫抑制治疗会让急性重症结肠炎得不到治疗。
feedback.en: Ischaemic colitis is usually an acute, segmental illness of older patients that seldom involves the rectum; it explains neither two years of relapsing bloody diarrhoea nor acute-on-chronic inflammation on biopsy. Withholding immunosuppression would leave an acute severe colitis untreated.

prompt.zh-CN: 这次发作控制之后，她需要一种减停激素的维持用药。头颅MRI示多发点状白质异常信号，脑脊液检查无异常；白质改变的原因尚未明确。你选择哪种方案？
prompt.en: Beyond this flare she will need a steroid-sparing maintenance drug. The brain MRI shows multifocal punctate white-matter abnormalities and the CSF is unremarkable; the cause of the white-matter changes is not established. Which plan do you choose?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 4，并看过头颅MRI和脑脊液报告。
need.en: Answer decision 4 and read the brain MRI and CSF reports first.

text.zh-CN: 硫唑嘌呤，按TPMT和NUDT15基因型定剂量，筛查乙肝、丙肝和HIV后开始，定期查血常规和肝功能
text.en: Azathioprine dosed by TPMT and NUDT15 genotype, started after hepatitis B, C and HIV screening, with regular blood counts and liver tests

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。BSG 2025建议对静脉激素有效的急性重症结肠炎患者用嘌呤类似物（或合适的先进治疗）维持，AGA 2024也建议用硫嘌呤类药物维持激素诱导的缓解；CPIC 2018更新版按TPMT和NUDT15基因型确定起始剂量，而亚洲患者的硫嘌呤骨髓毒性多由NUDT15变异引起。ECCO 2021要求在诊断时和免疫抑制治疗前筛查乙肝；骨髓毒性可在任何时间出现，要持续监测血常规。这一方案也暂时避开了在白质病变原因未明时使用抗TNF药物。
feedback.en: Right. BSG 2025 suggests a purine analogue (or a suitable advanced therapy) once acute severe colitis has responded to IV steroids, and AGA 2024 suggests a thiopurine to maintain a corticosteroid-induced remission; CPIC's 2018 update sets the starting dose by TPMT and NUDT15 genotype, and NUDT15 variants cause most thiopurine myelotoxicity in Asian patients. ECCO 2021 screens for hepatitis B at diagnosis and before immunosuppression, and counts are monitored because myelotoxicity can come at any time. The plan also avoids an anti-TNF drug while her white-matter lesions are unexplained.

text.zh-CN: 从今天起与激素同时口服硫唑嘌呤每日2.5 mg/kg，等到3个月后门诊复诊时再查第一次血常规和肝功能
text.en: Azathioprine 2.5 mg/kg daily from today alongside the steroids, with the first blood count and liver tests at the three-month clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 不查基因型就用足量、三个月内也不查血常规，正是漏掉严重硫嘌呤骨髓抑制的方式：NUDT15或TPMT慢代谢者可在数周内出现全血细胞减少（CPIC 2018）。应先检测，按基因型确定起始剂量，并尽早、定期查血常规。
feedback.en: Full dose without a genotype, and no blood count for three months, is how severe thiopurine myelosuppression is missed: a NUDT15 or TPMT poor metaboliser can become pancytopenic within weeks (CPIC 2018). Test first, start at the genotype-guided dose, and check counts early and regularly.

text.zh-CN: 只查TPMT酶活性后就开始硫唑嘌呤，因为在所有人群中，硫嘌呤毒性大多由TPMT缺乏引起
text.en: Azathioprine after a TPMT enzyme activity test alone, since TPMT deficiency explains most thiopurine toxicity in every population

feedback.zh-CN: 查TPMT是对的，但对她不够：TPMT缺乏是欧洲人和非洲人硫嘌呤不耐受的主要遗传原因，而亚洲人的硫嘌呤骨髓抑制多由NUDT15风险等位基因引起（CPIC 2018更新版）。TPMT结果正常并不能保护NUDT15慢代谢者。
feedback.en: TPMT testing is right but not enough for her: TPMT deficiency is the main inherited cause of thiopurine intolerance in Europeans and Africans, while NUDT15 risk alleles account for most thiopurine myelosuppression in Asians (CPIC 2018 update). A normal TPMT result does not protect a NUDT15 poor metaboliser.

text.zh-CN: 改用英夫利西单抗诱导和维持，现在就开始，作为最快的停激素途径，不等神经科对MRI的意见
text.en: Infliximab induction and maintenance instead, started now as the quickest way off steroids, without waiting for neurology's view of the MRI

feedback.zh-CN: 英夫利西单抗对中重度溃疡性结肠炎有效，但对她不能不先看脑部情况：她的白质病变原因未明，而英夫利西单抗说明书警示治疗中可新发或加重脱髓鞘疾病。如果需要先进治疗，应先请神经科评估MRI，并在使用任何抗TNF药物前筛查结核和乙肝。
feedback.en: Infliximab works in moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis, but not without looking at her brain first: her white-matter lesions are unexplained, and infliximab labelling warns that demyelinating disease can appear or worsen on treatment. If an advanced therapy is needed, neurology reviews the MRI first, and TB and hepatitis B screening come before any anti-TNF drug.

text.zh-CN: 长期小剂量泼尼松维持缓解，因白质病变而避免使用一切免疫抑制剂
text.en: Long-term low-dose prednisone to hold remission, avoiding every immunosuppressant because of the white-matter lesions

feedback.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素能诱导缓解，但不能维持缓解；长期使用带来骨质疏松、糖尿病、感染和白内障，却不能防止复发；指南的目标是无激素缓解（BSG 2025；ACG 2025）。白质病变是在神经科评估前避免抗TNF药物的理由，而不是放弃所有减停激素治疗的理由。
feedback.en: Corticosteroids induce remission but do not maintain it, and long-term use brings osteoporosis, diabetes, infection and cataract without preventing relapse; guidelines aim for steroid-free remission (BSG 2025; ACG 2025). The white-matter lesions are a reason to hold anti-TNF drugs until neurology has reviewed them, not to avoid all steroid-sparing treatment.

text.zh-CN: 问清便血（起始、次数、腹痛、发热、恶心呕吐）、记不起来的那个早上（恢复、有无目击者、神经系统症状）、两年的肠道病史、用药、旅行和接触史以及家族史
text.en: Took the bleeding history (onset, frequency, pain, fever, nausea), the story of the forgotten morning (recovery, any witness, neurological symptoms), the two-year bowel history, medicines, travel and contacts, and family history

text.zh-CN: 评估神志，做神经系统和腹部查体
text.en: Assessed her conscious level and examined her nervous system and abdomen

text.zh-CN: 入院阶段看过血常规、CRP和CT，并送检粪培养加艰难梭菌毒素和腹部平片
text.en: On admission read the blood count, CRP and CT, and sent stool cultures with C. difficile toxin and a plain abdominal film

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判定为急性重症结肠炎（决策 1）
text.en: Graded the flare as acute severe colitis at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对今天的治疗方案（决策 3），并请结直肠外科会诊、开始排便记录
text.en: Chose today's treatment plan at the first attempt (decision 3), involved the colorectal surgeon and started a stool chart

text.zh-CN: 入院阶段即给予静脉糖皮质激素（甲泼尼龙或氢化可的松）
text.en: Gave intravenous corticosteroids (methylprednisolone or hydrocortisone) in the admission phase

text.zh-CN: 入院阶段即预防血栓（低分子肝素；停用肝素时用间歇充气加压）
text.en: Gave thromboprophylaxis in the admission phase (LMWH, or pneumatic compression if heparin was withheld)

text.zh-CN: 没有用止泻药、阿片类、非甾体抗炎药或抗胆碱能解痉药，没有为全结肠镜做肠道准备，也没有足量抗凝
text.en: Gave no antidiarrhoeal, opioid, NSAID or anticholinergic antispasmodic, no bowel preparation for a full colonoscopy, and no full-dose anticoagulation

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对神经系统检查方案（决策 2），查找静脉成像，请神经内科会诊，并看过MRI和脑脊液报告
text.en: Chose the neurological work-up at the first attempt (decision 2), looked for venous imaging, asked neurology to see her, and read the MRI and CSF reports

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为未定型的炎症性肠病，感染、淋巴瘤和癌均无支持（决策 4）
text.en: Identified inflammatory bowel disease of unclassified type, with infection, lymphoma and carcinoma unsupported, at the first attempt (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择按基因型用药的硫唑嘌呤方案（决策 5），并送检TPMT/NUDT15基因检测和乙肝、丙肝、HIV血清学
text.en: Chose genotype-guided azathioprine at the first attempt (decision 5) and sent the TPMT/NUDT15 test and the hepatitis B, C and HIV serology

text.zh-CN: 用通俗语言向她说明病情轻重、治疗方案及其安全措施，以及肠道与脑部病变之间尚未明确的关系，并确认她已理解
text.en: Explained the severity, the treatment and its safety measures, and the uncertain bowel–brain link to her in plain words, and checked her understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge评价与患者的谈话：开始（自我介绍，确认她在频繁如厕之间能够交谈）；了解她的想法、担忧和期望（她怕是肿瘤，也担心脑子出了问题）；分段用通俗的话解释并随时核对理解——肠道炎症很重，需要住院静脉用激素；为什么要留大便标本、做不清肠的肠镜并取活检；为什么正在出血还要打预防血栓的针；为什么不用布洛芬、吗啡和止泻药；脑部MRI看到一些小的白质病灶，原因还不清楚，可能与肠道炎症有关但没有证实，还需要静脉成像、可能还有脑电图，以后复查MRI；共同商定计划（先做基因血液检查，再用减停激素的维持药物）；交代安全信号（腹痛加重、腹胀、头晕、出血增多，或新出现头痛、无力、意识混乱要马上告诉护士）。请她复述要点。活检结果出来前不作“不是癌”的虚假保证，不说肠道病“导致”了脑部改变，不提本病例没有记录的预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the conversation with her by Calgary–Cambridge: initiate (introduce yourself, check she can talk between trips to the toilet); gather her ideas, concerns and expectations (she fears a growth, and fears for her brain); explain in plain words, in chunks, checking as you go — the bowel is severely inflamed and needs steroids through a drip in hospital; why stool samples and a camera test without bowel preparation, with biopsies, are needed; why she has a blood-thinning injection although she is bleeding; why ibuprofen, morphine and anti-diarrhoea tablets are avoided; that the brain scan shows small white-matter spots whose cause is not yet known — a link with the bowel inflammation is possible but not proven, and vein imaging, perhaps an EEG and a later repeat scan will follow; plan together (a genetic blood test before a steroid-sparing maintenance drug); and safety-net (tell the nurse at once about worse pain, a swollen tummy, faintness, heavier bleeding, or a new headache, weakness or confusion). Use teach-back. No reassurance that it is not cancer before the biopsies, no claim that the bowel disease caused the brain changes, and no prognosis the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 郝医生（消化内科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，用PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“血便发作按什么标准分级？没有脉搏和体温，你还能判断吗？”“两年反复的血便、便意频繁，告诉你那天夜里开始的出血是什么性质？”“治疗前要送哪些标本？要等结果吗？”“CT上看到什么会让你暂缓激素？”“正在便血的结肠炎患者为什么还要用肝素？”“哪些止痛、止泻的药在重症发作时是危险的，为什么？”“第3天你怎样判断激素是否有效？谁需要从第一天起就知道她？”“30 cm处的环周病变让你担心什么？什么能回答这个问题？”“炎症性肠病的类型你能确定到什么程度？这会改变今天的治疗吗？”“给中国患者用硫唑嘌呤之前必须查什么？”“你会怎样向她解释肠道和脑部扫描之间的关系？”。可以讲BSG 2025、ACG 2025、AGA 2026临床实践更新、中国溃疡性结肠炎诊治指南（2023年·西安）、CAG 2014血栓预防共识、CPIC 2018硫嘌呤指南和ECCO 2024肠外表现指南的相关原则。原报告的处理是历史记录，在病例结束时才展示，届时再与现行做法对照（CPIC到2018年更新版才把NUDT15纳入指南）。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；她的生命体征、完整血液检查、排便记录、泼尼松和硫唑嘌呤的剂量、静脉成像和脑电图、最终的炎症性肠病类型以及随访后的情况都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who debriefs with PEARLS and asks only about what the learner already has, for example: 'Which criteria grade a flare of bloody diarrhoea, and can you grade it without a pulse or temperature?', 'What do two years of relapsing bloody, urgent stools tell you about the bleeding that began that night?', 'Which samples go off before treatment, and do you wait for them?', 'What on the CT would make you hold the steroids?', 'Why does a bleeding patient with colitis still need heparin?', 'Which drugs for pain and diarrhoea are dangerous in a severe flare, and why?', 'How will you know on day 3 whether the steroids are working, and who needs to know about her from day one?', 'What does a circumferential lesion at 30 cm make you worry about, and what answers it?', 'How sure can you be about the type of inflammatory bowel disease, and does it change today's treatment?', 'What must you check before azathioprine in a Chinese patient?', 'How would you explain the link between her bowel and the brain scan?'. May explain the relevant principles of BSG 2025, ACG 2025, the AGA 2026 clinical practice update, the 2023 Chinese UC guideline, CAG 2014 on thromboprophylaxis, CPIC 2018 on thiopurines and ECCO 2024 on extraintestinal manifestations. The report's management is a historical record shown at the end of the case, and is compared with current practice only then (CPIC added NUDT15 to its guidance only in the 2018 update). Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early; her vital signs, a full blood panel, her stool chart, the prednisone and azathioprine doses, venous imaging and EEG, the final type of inflammatory bowel disease and what happened after follow-up are not recorded — do not supply them.

name.zh-CN: 林护士（消化内科病房，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 消化内科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：S——38岁女性，大量便血收入病房，现每天十余次，伴右下腹痛和发热；B——某日早上有一段时间的事她回忆不起来，下午已神志清楚，当晚开始便血；两年来反复糊状血便；平时不吃特别的药；A——我这里没有可以交班的生命体征记录；R——请您评估并开治疗医嘱。可以协助建立静脉通路、留取血标本和大便标本、开始排便记录和生命体征监测、执行皮下和静脉用药、绑气压套筒、联系放射科拍床旁平片；治疗车和病房视频脑电图仪都在病房，报告在护士站病历终端查看。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（脉搏、血压、体温读数、体重）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Gastroenterology ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): S — 38-year-old woman admitted with heavy rectal bleeding, now more than ten times a day, with right lower abdominal pain and fever; B — one morning she had a spell she cannot recall and was alert again by the afternoon, and the bleeding began that night; two years of relapsing loose, bloody stools; nothing unusual in her medicines; A — I have no recorded set of observations to hand over; R — please assess her and write up her treatment. Can place a cannula, take bloods and stool samples, start a stool chart and observations, give subcutaneous and intravenous drugs, fit compression sleeves and call radiology for a portable film; the treatment cart and the ward video-EEG cart are on the ward, and reports are read at the nursing-station records terminal. Reads back orders, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (her pulse, blood pressure, temperature reading, weight).

knowledge.zh-CN: 神经内科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的神经系统资料。可以讲：年轻成人在炎症性肠病活动期出现一过性记忆和意识障碍的鉴别——脑静脉血栓形成、动脉缺血、癫痫发作、短暂性全面遗忘（意识保留）、脑炎、可逆性后部脑病综合征、脱髓鞘和中枢神经系统血管炎；为什么要用静脉成像（MR或CT静脉成像）排除静脉血栓（AHA 2024），以及弥散加权成像对急性缺血的意义；脑脊液和脑电图在什么时候有帮助；白质病变原因很多，常不特异，它与肠道疾病的关系只能作为需要随访的关联，而不是已证实的机制；英夫利西单抗说明书警示可新发或加重脱髓鞘疾病，所以抗TNF药物要等神经科评估后再定；环孢素可引起癫痫发作和脑病，低胆固醇或低镁时风险更高；预防剂量低分子肝素后至少12小时再做腰椎穿刺；以及复查MRI的价值。不补充本病例没有记录的序列、部位或数值。
knowledge.en: Neurology consultant who interprets only neurological records the learner has read. Can explain: the differential of a transient disturbance of memory and awareness in a young adult with active inflammatory bowel disease — cerebral venous thrombosis, arterial ischaemia, seizure, transient global amnesia (which preserves awareness), encephalitis, posterior reversible encephalopathy, demyelination and CNS vasculitis; why venous imaging (MR or CT venography) is needed to exclude venous thrombosis (AHA 2024) and what diffusion imaging adds for acute ischaemia; when CSF and an EEG help; that white-matter lesions have many causes and are often non-specific, so their link with the bowel disease is an association to follow, not a proven mechanism; that infliximab labelling warns of new or worsening demyelinating disease, so anti-TNF drugs wait for a neurology view; that ciclosporin can cause seizures and encephalopathy, more so with low cholesterol or magnesium; that a lumbar puncture is timed at least 12 hours after a prophylactic LMWH dose; and the value of a repeat MRI. Adds no sequence, site or value the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病理科医生，只解读学员已经看过的活检和内镜报告。可以讲：“严重急慢性炎症”意味着什么；区分溃疡性结肠炎和克罗恩结肠炎的组织学线索（弥漫性隐窝结构改变和基底浆细胞增多，与肉芽肿和斑片状病变相对），以及为什么重症发作时一次活检可能定不了型；隐窝脓肿常见但不特异；为什么对环周病变做淋巴瘤免疫组化，“不支持淋巴瘤”能排除什么、不能排除什么；急性重症结肠炎时在结肠组织上做巨细胞病毒免疫组化或PCR；以及炎症消退后再次活检的价值。不补充本病例没有记录的抗体、部位或所见。
knowledge.en: Pathologist who interprets only biopsy and endoscopy reports the learner has read. Can explain: what 'severe acute and chronic inflammation' means; the histological clues that separate ulcerative colitis from Crohn's colitis (diffuse crypt architectural distortion and basal plasmacytosis against granulomas and patchy disease), and why one set of biopsies in a severe flare may not settle the type; that crypt abscesses are common but not specific; why a circumferential lesion is stained for lymphoma, and what 'does not support lymphoma' does and does not exclude; CMV immunohistochemistry or PCR on colonic tissue in acute severe colitis; and the value of repeat biopsies once the inflammation settles. Adds no antibody, site or finding the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：急性重症结肠炎，伴原因未明的一过性神经系统事件
title.en: Debrief: acute severe colitis with an unexplained transient neurological episode

conclusion.zh-CN: 38岁女性，两年来反复糊状血便伴便意频繁，自认为与压力有关；某日早上的事回忆不起来，下午神志清楚，当晚起大量便血，伴右下腹痛和发热，之后每天十余次。血红蛋白由129降至93 g/L，CRP 95.8 mg/L，符合Truelove–Witts急性重症结肠炎。CT示升结肠和直肠壁增厚；内镜见约30 cm处不规则环周隆起，远端弥漫浅溃疡、糜烂和充血；活检为严重急慢性炎症，未见明确隐窝脓肿或肿瘤细胞，免疫组化不支持淋巴瘤；粪便病原学反复阴性。头颅MRI示多发点状白质异常，脑脊液无异常。原报告用泼尼松和硫唑嘌呤治疗，随访MRI部分消退、肠镜黏膜改善；炎症性肠病类型和脑部病变机制均未明确。按现行做法：送检标本后静脉甲泼尼龙，加低分子肝素预防血栓，避免止泻药、阿片类和非甾体抗炎药，第3天与外科共同评估，做脑静脉成像，查TPMT/NUDT15后再用硫唑嘌呤。
conclusion.en: A 38-year-old woman with two years of relapsing loose, bloody stools and urgency, which she put down to stress, could not recall one morning and was alert by the afternoon; that night heavy rectal bleeding began with right lower abdominal pain and fever, rising to more than ten stools a day. Hb fell from 129 to 93 g/L and CRP was 95.8 mg/L: acute severe colitis by Truelove and Witts. CT showed thickening of the ascending colon and rectum; endoscopy an irregular circumferential lesion at about 30 cm with diffuse shallow ulcers, erosions and erythema distally; biopsies severe acute and chronic inflammation without definite crypt abscesses or tumour cells, with immunohistochemistry against lymphoma; repeated stool tests were negative. Brain MRI showed multifocal punctate white-matter changes; CSF was unremarkable. The report gave prednisone and azathioprine; at follow-up the MRI changes partly resolved and the mucosa improved, while the type of inflammatory bowel disease and the mechanism of the brain lesions stayed unestablished. Today: IV methylprednisolone once samples are sent, LMWH prophylaxis, no antidiarrhoeals, opioids or NSAIDs, a joint day-3 review with the surgeon, cerebral venous imaging, and azathioprine only after TPMT/NUDT15 testing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 长病史改变了对急性表现的解读：两年反复血便伴便意频繁，使那天夜里开始的大出血成为慢性结肠炎的一次重症发作，而不是第一次出血或一次食物中毒。
keyReasoning.en: A long history reframes the acute picture: two years of relapsing bloody diarrhoea with urgency make the heavy bleeding that began that night a severe flare of a chronic colitis, not a first bleed or a bout of food poisoning.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 按已有记录分级：每天十余次血便加血红蛋白93 g/L已符合Truelove–Witts标准；缺少脉搏和体温只说明分级不完整，不说明病情较轻。
keyReasoning.en: Severity is graded on what is recorded: more than ten bloody stools a day with an Hb of 93 g/L already meet Truelove and Witts; missing pulse and temperature readings make the grade incomplete, not milder.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 安全措施与治疗同步：先送标本、不等结果即用激素；虽在便血也照样预防血栓，因为结肠炎出血本身不是停用的理由；抑制结肠的药物一律不用。
keyReasoning.en: Safety runs alongside treatment: samples go off and steroids start without waiting; thromboprophylaxis is given although she is bleeding, because colitic bleeding is not in itself a reason to withhold it; drugs that slow the colon are withheld.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肿块样病变要靠组织而不是靠印象：活检和免疫组化回答淋巴瘤和癌的问题，病变持续存在就在发作后再次活检。
keyReasoning.en: A mass-like lesion needs tissue, not a label: biopsies with immunohistochemistry answer lymphoma and carcinoma, and a lesion that persists is biopsied again after the flare.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 炎症发作期出现的神经系统事件要按可能的并发症检查——先排除血栓；肠–脑关系只能说“可能相关”，因为没有确证机制。
keyReasoning.en: A neurological event during a flare is investigated as a possible complication — thrombosis first — and the bowel–brain link is stated as possible, not proven, because no mechanism was established.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 长期治疗的选择要顾及这位患者特有的风险：东亚患者要查硫嘌呤相关基因型，白质病变原因未明时对抗TNF药物要谨慎。
keyReasoning.en: Long-term treatment is chosen with this patient's particular risks in view: the thiopurine genotype in an East Asian patient, and caution with anti-TNF drugs while her white-matter lesions are unexplained.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能证明是哪种药物起效，不能确定炎症性肠病的类型，也不能解释脑部病变。任何阶段都没有生命体征记录，所以严重程度分级和第3天疗效都无法凭记录完成；各项检查的时间也没有记录，本病例把血常规、CRP和CT放在入院阶段，把粪便、内镜、活检、MRI和脑脊液报告放在住院检查阶段。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。
boundaries.en: A single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show which drug helped, settle the type of inflammatory bowel disease or explain the brain lesions. No vital signs are recorded at any stage, so neither the severity grade nor the day-3 response can be completed from the record; the timing of the tests is not recorded either, so the case places the blood count, CRP and CT on admission and the stool, endoscopy, biopsy, MRI and CSF reports in the work-up phase. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何阶段的生命体征（脉搏、体温读数、血压、呼吸、血氧饱和度）——Truelove–Witts标准中的脉搏和体温两项无法评定。
unknowns.en: Vital signs at any stage (pulse, temperature reading, blood pressure, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation) — the pulse and temperature items of Truelove and Witts cannot be scored.

unknowns.zh-CN: 那个早上到底发生了什么（有无目击者、持续多久、有无抽搐表现、当时的血糖），以及以前有无类似发作。
unknowns.en: What happened during the morning she cannot recall (any witness account, its duration, any features of a seizure, a glucose at the time) and whether there were earlier episodes.

unknowns.zh-CN: 其余血液检查：白细胞、血小板、血沉、白蛋白、电解质（含血镁）、肝肾功能、凝血；两次血红蛋白的检测时间；是否输过血。
unknowns.en: The rest of the blood work: white cells, platelets, ESR, albumin, electrolytes including magnesium, renal and liver tests, clotting; when the two haemoglobin values were taken; any transfusion.

unknowns.zh-CN: 具体做了哪些其他感染检查（活检巨细胞病毒、血培养、乙肝、丙肝、HIV、结核），粪便标本送检了几次。
unknowns.en: Which other infection tests were done (CMV in the biopsies, blood cultures, hepatitis B and C, HIV, tuberculosis) and how many stool samples were tested.

unknowns.zh-CN: 内镜和病理细节：进镜深度、是否做过肠道准备、30 cm以上结肠的情况、活检部位、免疫组化抗体、有无肉芽肿或巨细胞病毒染色；是否拍过腹部平片；CT细节（是否增强、结肠管径）。
unknowns.en: Endoscopy and pathology details: how far the scope passed, whether the bowel was prepared, the colon above 30 cm, the biopsy sites, the immunohistochemistry panel, any granulomas or CMV staining; any plain abdominal film; the CT details (contrast, colonic calibre).

unknowns.zh-CN: 神经系统资料：MRI序列和病灶部位、静脉或动脉成像、脑电图，脑脊液细胞数、蛋白、葡萄糖及检测的病原体。
unknowns.en: Neurological details: MRI sequences and lesion sites, venous or arterial imaging, an EEG, and the CSF cell counts, protein, glucose and the pathogens tested.

unknowns.zh-CN: 治疗与随访：泼尼松和硫唑嘌呤的剂量、途径、开始时间和疗程，是否检测TPMT/NUDT15或酶活性，是否预防血栓，第3天的疗效，有无挽救治疗，随访间隔和最终的炎症性肠病类型；她的其他病史（过敏、其他疾病、手术、家族史、吸烟饮酒、旅行接触、肠外症状、妊娠状态）。
unknowns.en: Treatment and follow-up: the prednisone and azathioprine doses, route, start and duration, any TPMT/NUDT15 or enzyme testing, thromboprophylaxis, the day-3 response, any rescue therapy, the follow-up interval and the final type of inflammatory bowel disease; her other history (allergies, illnesses, operations, family history, smoking and alcohol, travel and contacts, extraintestinal symptoms, pregnancy status).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 急性重症结肠炎：每天血便≥6次，加至少一项全身中毒表现——脉搏>90次/分、体温>37.8 ℃、血红蛋白<105 g/L或血沉>30 mm/h（现多以CRP>30 mg/L代替）（Truelove–Witts 1955，BSG指南沿用）。她仅凭排便次数和血红蛋白就已符合。AGA 2026临床实践更新要求所有住院的炎症性肠病患者送检粪便培养、两步法艰难梭菌检测并做断层影像，可能需要结肠切除时请外科会诊。本病例没有记录原报告的严重程度评估。
teachingPoints.en: Acute severe colitis is ≥ 6 bloody stools a day with at least one sign of systemic toxicity — pulse > 90/min, temperature > 37.8 °C, Hb < 105 g/L or ESR > 30 mm/h (CRP > 30 mg/L is now often used instead) (Truelove and Witts 1955, the definition BSG guidance uses). She met it on frequency and Hb alone. The AGA 2026 clinical practice update asks for stool culture, two-step C. difficile testing and cross-sectional imaging in every hospitalised IBD patient, and a surgical consultation whenever colectomy may be needed. This case does not record how the report graded her.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 一线治疗为静脉甲泼尼龙60 mg/24 h或氢化可的松100 mg每6小时（BSG 2025；ACG 2025；更大剂量无额外获益，BSG 2025和AGA 2026）。第3天评估：每天排便>8次，或3–8次且CRP>45 mg/L，在生物制剂时代之前预测85%需结肠切除（Travis 1996），如今提示需要英夫利西单抗或环孢素挽救治疗，或与结直肠外科商定手术。原报告用的是泼尼松（剂量和途径未记录）；本病例无法显示她第3天的反应。
teachingPoints.en: First-line treatment is IV methylprednisolone 60 mg/24 h or hydrocortisone 100 mg 6-hourly (BSG 2025; ACG 2025; higher doses add nothing, BSG 2025 and AGA 2026). On day 3, more than 8 stools a day, or 3–8 with CRP > 45 mg/L, predicted colectomy in 85 % in the pre-biologic era (Travis 1996) and now calls for rescue with infliximab or ciclosporin, or surgery agreed with the colorectal surgeon. The report used prednisone (dose and route not recorded); this case cannot show her day-3 response.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 所有因炎症性肠病发作住院的患者都要预防血栓：炎症性肠病使静脉血栓栓塞风险约增至3倍，发作期更高（CAG 2014）；BSG 2019和BSG 2025对急性重症结肠炎使用预防剂量低分子肝素，并指出它不会诱发或加重结肠出血；CAG 2014建议无活动性出血时使用，出血不严重时也建议使用——只有出血重到威胁循环时才改为机械预防并每天复评。避免抑制结肠或加重炎症的药物：阿片类（与中毒性巨结肠相关，BSG 2019）、止泻药和抗胆碱能药（洛哌丁胺说明书：急性溃疡性结肠炎禁用）以及非甾体抗炎药（加重活动期炎症性肠病，BSG 2019）；用不经肠道准备的乙状结肠镜加活检（BSG 2019；BSG 2025）。本病例没有记录她是否接受过血栓预防。
teachingPoints.en: Every inpatient with an IBD flare needs thromboprophylaxis: IBD roughly triples the risk of venous thromboembolism, more in a flare (CAG 2014); BSG 2019 and BSG 2025 give prophylactic LMWH in acute severe colitis and note that it does not precipitate or exacerbate colonic bleeding, and CAG 2014 recommends it with no active bleeding and suggests it when bleeding is non-severe — only bleeding severe enough to threaten the circulation turns it into mechanical prophylaxis with daily review. Avoid what slows the colon or inflames it: opioids (linked with toxic megacolon, BSG 2019), antidiarrhoeals and anticholinergics (loperamide labelling: contraindicated in acute ulcerative colitis) and NSAIDs (worse active IBD, BSG 2019); use an unprepared flexible sigmoidoscopy with biopsies (BSG 2019; BSG 2025). This case does not record whether she received thromboprophylaxis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 粪便检查反复阴性、两年反复发作和活检的急慢性炎症，使炎症性肠病成为诊断；当病变分布（远端弥漫溃疡伴升结肠增厚）和一次活检不能定型时，可暂定为未定型炎症性肠病——在我国，肠结核和白塞病也是需要记住的鉴别。环周病变要做淋巴瘤免疫组化并在发作后复查；本例随访时肠镜黏膜已改善。
teachingPoints.en: Negative repeated stool tests, two years of relapsing symptoms and acute-on-chronic inflammation on biopsy make inflammatory bowel disease the diagnosis; it can stay unclassified when the distribution (diffuse distal ulceration with ascending-colon thickening) and one set of biopsies do not settle the type — in China, intestinal tuberculosis and Behçet's disease are mimics to keep in mind. A circumferential lesion is stained for lymphoma and re-examined after the flare; here the mucosa had improved at follow-up colonoscopy.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 炎症性肠病发作期出现的一过性记忆和意识障碍要检查，而不是安慰了事：头颅MRI（含弥散加权成像）加MR或CT静脉成像排除脑静脉血栓形成（AHA 2024科学声明），怀疑感染或炎症时查脑脊液，怀疑发作时做脑电图。她的MRI示多发点状白质异常、脑脊液无异常，随访时部分消退——这与肠道疾病的关联本病例没有确证机制，血管炎或脱髓鞘都未得到证实。
teachingPoints.en: A transient disturbance of memory and awareness during an IBD flare is investigated, not reassured: brain MRI with diffusion imaging plus MR or CT venography for cerebral venous thrombosis (AHA 2024 scientific statement), CSF when infection or inflammation is possible, and an EEG for seizure. Her MRI showed multifocal punctate white-matter abnormalities with an unremarkable CSF, partly resolving at follow-up — an association with the bowel disease for which this case records no confirmed mechanism; neither vasculitis nor demyelination was proven.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 用硫嘌呤类药物之前要查TPMT和NUDT15基因型：CPIC 2018更新版按两者确定起始剂量，亚洲患者的硫嘌呤骨髓抑制多由NUDT15风险等位基因引起；免疫抑制前筛查乙肝（ECCO 2021）。原报告使用硫唑嘌呤时，NUDT15尚未进入指南，本病例也没有记录是否检测过TPMT；如今这已是常规准备。白质病变原因未明时，抗TNF药物要等神经科评估（英夫利西单抗说明书：可新发或加重脱髓鞘疾病）。
teachingPoints.en: Before a thiopurine, genotype TPMT and NUDT15: CPIC's 2018 update sets the starting dose by both, and NUDT15 risk alleles account for most thiopurine myelosuppression in Asian patients; screen for hepatitis B before immunosuppression (ECCO 2021). When the report's team used azathioprine, NUDT15 was not yet in guidance, and this case does not record whether TPMT was tested; today it is routine preparation. While white-matter lesions are unexplained, anti-TNF drugs wait for a neurology view (infliximab labelling: new or worsening demyelinating disease).
